items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. Its responsibilities have been transferred to Somali institutions and U.N. agencies. The mission's roots dates back to 1995, when the U.N. established its Political Office for Somalia. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024. items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year. items.title: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 29 OTT - The shareholders of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Thursday rejected a proposal for the bank to merge with Mediobanca. The proposal needed the support of two-thirds of the bank's capital to be approved, but 63.65% voted against, with only 32.91% in favour and 3.42% abstaining. The merger was part of CEO Luigi Lovaglio's plan to fend off a 33-billion-euro takeover ‌bid by Intesa Sanpaolo for MPS. items.titleIt: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
